host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authorized: reversible replacement of Gemma4 RMSNorm forward methods under model.language_model
C02-S.O bitsandbytes NF4 replay of the frozen 5 tapes / 11 requests

semantics.v_norm_semantics: no learned scale and no weight tensor

custom_op.schema: k1_gemma4_rmsnorm(Tensor hidden_states, Tensor? weight, float epsilon) -> Tensor
custom_op.fake_meta_implementation: returns empty_like(hidden_states) after shape/dtype contract checks

fallback_boundary.cpu: semantic eager fallback for non-formal tests only; every CPU dispatch is counted and makes a formal run fail
fallback_boundary.formal_cuda: BF16 CUDA, contiguous, final-axis stride 1, optional same-device/same-dtype direct scale
fallback_boundary.unsupported: raise; never silently fall back during formal replay

custom_op.autograd: not registered; OP3 runs under torch.inference_mode() only

reconnection.method: temporarily bind an instance forward that calls torch.ops.edgeforge.k1_gemma4_rmsnorm.default; delete the instance override on restore
invariants: named module names, types, and object identities do not change
named parameter names, object identities, data pointers, shapes, dtypes, and devices do not change
all RMSNorm weight object identities remain unchanged
persistent CPU embedding storage and tied lm_head identity do not change
the original forward resolution is restored before process exit

decoding.eos_policy: record EOS positions but do not truncate; generate the exact frozen completion budget so OP1 frequency accounting remains comparable
decoding.kv_policy: fresh cache per request; no cache crosses request boundaries

replay.measurement_convention: replay all requests of one tape in each pass; pass 1 primes code/data caches and pass 2 alone contributes end-to-end metrics

request_metrics: TTFT wall milliseconds from CPU embedding start through first greedy token
incremental TPOT wall milliseconds excluding the first token

kernel_metrics.invocations: count every B custom-op CUDA implementation dispatch by request, pass, phase, runtime shape, module name, and scale variant
kernel_metrics.signature: phase + flattened rows + normalized width + input dtype + with_scale

thermal_protocol.memory_clock_is_reported_but_not_a_hard_: hybrid CPU lm_head creates expected GPU-idle gaps unlike the OP0 continuous bandwidth loop

comparison_order: A2 versus B2 only after reporting A1/A2
correctness.strong_pass: all generated token IDs match position-by-position for every request
divergence_record: absolute context position = rendered prompt length + generated-token index
both token IDs at the first differing position
eight-token prefix context before the difference
both generated lengths and remaining suffix lengths
correctness.bnb_nondeterminism_rule: if A1/A2 diverges, report A/B as confounded and do not attribute all A/B divergence to K1
direct_fail: state_dict, parameter, module, device_map, or RMSNorm weight identity drift

pass_requires: config hash unchanged from process start through final receipt write
all reconnect and carrier invariants pass
all 5 tapes / 11 requests finish twice on A and twice on B
only pass-2 A/B records contribute end-to-end aggregates
all B calls dispatch through the CUDA custom op with exact census-frequency reconciliation
no direct-fail condition or thermal/hardware throttle occurs
A/A and A/B token comparisons are fully recorded; token divergence alone is reportable and does not fail if tensor contracts and baseline confounding rules are honored
